change_summary: The alert records a retraction notice with DOI 10.9999/fake.2020.024, detected on 2026-10-01, and the tracked paper's own DOI is 10.9999/fake.2020.024. No separate retraction notice or notice text was provided, and the current copy shows no retraction watermark or banner. The current copy still reports AAD in 18 of 156 participants given LGG and 33 of 156 given placebo, and it still concludes that LGG reduced AAD and was well tolerated. The paper was published online in April 2020.

alerts.what_changed: Nothing visible. The retraction alert points to a notice whose DOI is the paper's own DOI. There is no separate notice text, and the current copy downloaded on 2026-10-02 shows no retraction mark and has the same content as the stored paper. Only metadata is available.
